svg.aria-label: Dual-Review independence diagram: author submits a proposal; Internal review (same agent type, fresh session) helps it land; External review (different agent type or human) makes it prove it should land.
svg.text: A different model architecture is a more enforceable conflict-of-interest
criterion than institutional independence — it makes the reviewer far
less likely to share the author's blind spot. Solo team? Fresh-session
review is the floor; External lands when a second agent type is available.
